name: osint
description: Open source intelligence (OSINT) research skill — investigate people, locations, domains, images, infrastructure, and digital artifacts using publicly available information

TAVILY_API_KEY.title: Tavily API key
TAVILY_API_KEY.description: Tavily API key for focused web search and content extraction. Get one at https://tavily.com. Leave blank to disable the tavily MCP server.

GEMINI_API_KEY.title: Google Gemini API key
GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key for AI analysis of images, video, and audio. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Leave blank to disable the gemini MCP server.

GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY.title: Google Cloud Vision API key
GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY.description: Google Cloud Vision API key for reverse image search. Enable the Cloud Vision API at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials. Free tier 1000 calls/month. Leave blank to disable the google-reverse-image MCP server.

SEARXNG_URL.title: SearXNG URL
SEARXNG_URL.description: URL of your SearXNG instance for multi-engine web search. Defaults to http://localhost:8080. See https://github.com/lawriec/mcp-searxng for Docker setup. Leave blank to use the default.

YTDLP_COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER.title: yt-dlp cookies — browser name
YTDLP_COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER.description: Optional: browser name (chrome, firefox, edge, safari, opera, brave, chromium) for yt-dlp to read YouTube cookies from. Strongly recommended for sustained yt-dlp use — without cookies, YouTube blocks most requests. Leave blank to skip.

YTDLP_COOKIES_FILE.title: yt-dlp cookies — file path
YTDLP_COOKIES_FILE.description: Optional: absolute path to a Netscape-format cookies.txt file for yt-dlp. Takes priority over YTDLP_COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER if both are set. Required for the Docker container (no host browser available). Leave blank to skip.

REDDIT_CLIENT_ID.title: Reddit OAuth client ID
REDDIT_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional: Reddit OAuth client ID for higher rate limits on the reddit MCP. Create one at https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps. Leave blank to use anonymous mode (works but rate-limited).

REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Reddit OAuth client secret
REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional: Reddit OAuth client secret matching REDDIT_CLIENT_ID. Leave blank to skip.

REDDIT_REFRESH_TOKEN.title: Reddit OAuth refresh token
REDDIT_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Optional: Reddit OAuth refresh token for persistent authentication. Leave blank to skip.
